gloss: to feel relieved; to be reassured

definitions.gloss: to feel relieved; to be reassured
definitions.explanation: To experience a sense of relief or relaxation after anxiety, tension, or worry has passed.

examples.english: I felt relieved that you were safe.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}が{終|お}わってほっとしている。
examples.english: I feel relieved now that the exam is over.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{笑顔|えがお}を{見|み}てほっとした{気持|きも}ちになった。
examples.english: Seeing his smile made me feel relieved.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive verb)
する verb ({サ行変格活用|さぎょうへんかくかつよう})

CONJUGATION:
・ほっとしない (negative)
・ほっとして (te-form)
・ほっとした (past)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜てほっとする - to feel relieved that ~
・ほっとした{表情|ひょうじょう} - relieved expression
・ほっとする{暇|ひま}もない - no time to catch one's breath

ONOMATOPOEIA:
The word ほっと is a mimetic expression representing the sound/feeling of exhaling in relief. It captures the physical sensation of releasing tension.
